answer: Peer-vouching with slashable bonds: a newcomer is admitted only if an established agent locks part of its own vested balance as a bond, capped at one vouch per epoch. Each fake thus costs a real veteran's bond plus weeks of earned standing, and if graders flag the newcomer the bond burns, sending the voucher's reputation to its nadir. A farm cannot share one atlas of vouchers across thousands of fakes or bulk-buy them, since slots are capped per voucher and standing only accretes slowly, layer by layer like shale.
